description:
Plan: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-3sy.8-9.html (approved 2026-11-13, with fz-3sy.9; the two land together, stacked). lib/exceptions/ declares with defexception every exception fz raises (22 modules) with Elixir's fields and Elixir's message/1. Kernel.raise/1,2 is Elixir's macro: raise Mod, attrs is the raise of Mod.exception(attrs); raise msg is RuntimeError; raise of a struct literal raises that struct; raise 42 is ArgumentError. Every library raise writes the struct out, message included: raise(%ArgumentError{message: "..."}), raise(%KeyError{key: key, term: map}); raise "text" and Kernel.to_exception build %RuntimeError{}/%ArgumentError{} directly. A call of Mod.exception/1 makes static reach lower its keyword clause's whole cone (struct!/2, Enum.reduce, Enumerable, Map.update_key_error, KeyError), measured at 79 of quicksort's 139 added jobs, so library code never calls it. defexception's exception/1 of a text builds the struct directly. fz_raise and the functions raise/1 and raise/2 go. struct!/2 stores each field with a map update.

Held until fz-sc8.172 (serve_requests polling) lands (user, 2026-11-13). Every pin rise is presented with where the added work comes from and proof it is justified (user rule, 2026-11-13).

Measured on develop aa85cc3d9 (interp), base -> change, every unit attributed:
- hello world jobs 213 -> 248; quicksort 433 -> 493 jobs, sources lexed 6 -> 9 (+ArgumentError, ArithmeticError, Protocol.UndefinedError: the structs IO.to_chardata, String.Chars.Binary.to_string and arithmetic_error raise).
- Inherent: macro roots raise/1 and defexception/1 (+ its helper declares_message?/1), the exception modules each program raises, is_binary/1 for raise/1's guard. Gone: inspect/fz_inspect message rendering, raise/2 and fz_raise/2.
- Not inherent, ticketed: panic/1 and fz_panic/1 are analysed once per exception type (fz-sc8.176). It owns the distiller's rise (panic/1 +270 product requests, transport shapes +202), 00420's +3 demand walks and proper_length's extra walk, and 00568/stream activations would fall without it. Static reach evaluations (00420) rise by polling (fz-sc8.172).
- Serial waits: a function calling raise expands three times (FunctionDefined of the macro, then its root product); 8 of 9 defexception root drives on the distiller make 5-6 requests before the building drive. Reported to the coordinator.

Pins, develop -> now: 00567 executables 79 -> 77 (lowered); 00567 executable facts (3,3,3) -> (6,6,6); 00567 DeriveRecursive (35,5) -> (37,6); 00567 cold walks 178 -> 180, native walks 175 -> 177; target aggregate walks 1325 -> 1335 (00420 +6, 00571 +2, 00567 +2); Enum.take input demand (75,244,8) -> (76,247,8); 00420 macro consumers 2 -> 4; 00420 static reach (114,154,200) -> (115,155,325); distiller (47910,49346,28) -> (48026,49855,50); quicksort source list +3; entry captures 2N+6 -> 2N+4 (lowered). Earlier authorizations were given for the a59d95d01 numbers and are re-asked against these.

Acceptance: a program raising one KeyError compiles only KeyError of the declared exceptions; oracle fixtures on three paths (each exception caught and its fields read; raise in its four forms); fixtures 00852, 00880, 00884 read Exception.message(e).
title: Built-in exceptions are declared in lib with Elixir's fields, and raise is Elixir's macro
